description: Perch: /perch (the task board menu) and the hooks that tell the Perch host on this machine about each session event (questions, permissions, plans, turns ending, usage limits).

hooks.command: [ "$OS" = Windows_NT ] || exit 0; d="${PERCH_STATE_DIR:-${APPDATA:+$APPDATA/perch}}"; read -r p 2>/dev/null <"${d:-$HOME/.perch}/port"; case "$p" in ""|*[!0-9]*) p=8787;; esac; curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @- "http://127.0.0.1:$p/hook" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0 # perch-hook

[ "$OS" = Windows_NT ] && exit 0; d="${PERCH_STATE_DIR:-${APPDATA:+$APPDATA/perch}}"; read -r p 2>/dev/null <"${d:-$HOME/.perch}/port"; case "$p" in ""|*[!0-9]*) p=8787;; esac; curl -sf --connect-timeout 1 -m 2 -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @- "http://127.0.0.1:$p/hook?check=1" 2>/dev/null; exit 0 # perch-hook
